title: Logo reveal
prompt: Logo reveal for "NOVA", a small fintech. Build a simple geometric mark (a circle and a diagonal slash work) next to the wordmark. The mark draws/assembles first, then the wordmark slides out from behind it, then a tagline "Money, made simple" fades in underneath. Navy background, one accent color. End on a clean hold of the full lockup for at least a second.

checklist.text: mark built from shapes (≥2 non-text layers)
sequenced: mark → wordmark → tagline (≥3 entrance waves)
wordmark revealed from behind the mark (mask/clip or layer order)
